name: Project Indicators Report2
query:
SELECT 
    pr.name AS project_id,
    p.name AS proposal_id,
    l.name AS Indicator,
    l.acheivement AS Actual,
    l.target,
    l.achievement_percentage
FROM 
    `tabTFD Projects` pr
JOIN 
    `tabTFD Main Proposal` p ON p.project = pr.name
JOIN 
    `tabTFD Logframe` l ON p.log_frame_name = l.logframe_name
    AND l.type = 'Ind'
WHERE
    (%(project)s = '' OR pr.name = %(project)s)
ORDER BY 
    pr.name, l.name;
